note: Stage-0 identity/license/runtime eligibility qualification only. No candidate is declared frontier-class, benchmark-qualified, or Genesis-selected by this registry. All revision/license/parameter data below was retrieved live via the Hugging Face Hub API (metadata only -- no weight shards were downloaded). Phase 21B.4.10.1 replaces the v1 conflated 'stage0_status' field on deployable candidates with four separate fields (identity_status, license_status, runtime_qualification_status, runtime_smoke_eligibility) so that 'runtime not yet qualified' (which is exactly what a runtime smoke test exists to resolve) is never confused with 'not eligible to attempt a smoke test'. runtime_smoke_eligibility=ELIGIBLE means only that a future phase MAY attempt to LOAD that candidate, never that it is qualified, selected, or frontier-class.
